newsitem.title: LEBANON: SOLIDERE shares mixed in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: SOLIDERE shares mixed in Beirut.

text.p: SOLIDERE A shares fell and B shares rose on Wednesday in reduced turnover on the Beirut Stock exchange (BSE).
A shares fell to $111 from Tuesday's $111.375 and B shares rose to $113.1250 from $113.
Turnover fell to 4,420 shares from Tuesday's 5,502 and value was $492,795.5 from $616,989.5.
For the third day running this week, there was no trade in the four other listed companies: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The LISPI stock index was down 0.03 percent to 83.78 and the BLOM stock index went down 0.08 percent to 958.67.
